answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bond in a ferrous vault that must wander to a new vault each epoch. Each move posts an echo record to a public log naming both vaults and the funding wallet for auditors to count identities per wallet. A move costs 10 plus 5 per identity already funded by that wallet, so the k-th fake pays 10+5(k-1) plus its 60 lock; fees grow quadratically, and 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 and pay 2,507,500. An honest agent locks 60 once and pays 10 per move. A rented-funder ring fails: the echo trail is public, and two identities from one wallet sharing a vault forfeit both bonds.
